verdicts.evidence_summary: QA-dominant cleanly partitions soft-middle panel into qa_clear (2), qa_review (4), qa_blocked (2).
verdicts.interpretation_note: Distinct QA-dominant family behavior survives mixed-evidence weighting.

verdicts.evidence_summary: Clear-evidence same-family optional case remains safe-like in follow-through; mixed same-family optional cases remain review rather than blocked.
verdicts.interpretation_note: Optional same-family remains closer to review/safe lanes than collapse lanes, with checkpoint mixed cases still evidence-limited.

verdicts.evidence_summary: Panel remains interpretable with anchors, blocked controls, mixed review, and optional roles; no collapse into undifferentiated ambiguity.
verdicts.interpretation_note: Taxonomy remains usable, but fine boundaries should stay guarded.

verdicts.evidence_summary: Mixed-evidence cases share qa_review primary state but split under structural lenses (needs_disambiguation vs separable; medium vs high risk).
verdicts.interpretation_note: Structural nuance re-enters as secondary prioritization, not as a replacement for QA-dominant primary classification.

verdicts.evidence_summary: Mixed cases separate into higher-priority review (sst2-mrpc) versus lower-priority review (yelp-mrpc) while both remain non-clear, non-blocked.
verdicts.interpretation_note: Useful triage differentiation exists inside review state, but requires explicit guardrails on threshold claims.

summary.bottom_line: Soft-middle triage remains structured and interpretable, but fine-grained boundaries stay guarded.
